mapper.select: select r.reservationNo, COALESCE(rh.realhotelname, h.hotelName) as realhotelname, hr.roomname, r.realUser, r.userAmount, r.checkInDate as checkIndate, r.checkOutDate from reservation r join hotel_room hr on r.roomNo = hr.roomNo join hotel h on hr.hotelNo = h.hotelNo left join realhotel rh on h.realhotelno = rh.realhotelno where r.memberno = #{memberno} order by r.reservationNo desc
mapper.delete: delete from reservation where reservationNo = #{reservationNo} and memberNo = #{memberNo}
mapper.select: select h.hotelno, COALESCE(rh.realhotelname, h.hotelName) as realhotelname, COALESCE(rh.state, h.mainAddress) as state, (select min(hi.hotelFileName) from hotel_image hi where hi.hotelNo = h.hotelNo) as hotelFileName from hotel h left join realhotel rh on h.realhotelno = rh.realhotelno join wishList w on w.hotelno = h.hotelno where w.memberno = #{memberno}
select count(*) from wishList where memberNo = #{memberNo} and hotelNo = #{hotelNo}
mapper.insert: insert into wishList(wishListNo, memberNo, hotelNo) values (wishList_seq.nextval, #{memberNo}, #{hotelNo})
mapper.delete: delete from wishList where memberNo = #{memberNo} and hotelNo = #{hotelNo}
